mission: Skip collector rollout and RAW DDL for documentation-only staging merges; bound read-only verifier GET timeouts

impacts.reason: Delivery workflow gains a fail-closed, file-allowlist scope step that can only remove collector rollout and RAW DDL for documentation-only merges; verification and state regeneration always run. Verifier retries only socket timeouts on read-only GETs (max 2) with identical assertions. No collector, API runtime, schema, cron, budget, pacing, claim or writer change; this PR requests no collector rollout.

routes: GitHub Actions staging-automerge delivery job; read-only staging verification GETs
dependencies: Existing manifest-driven deploy/migration scripts unchanged; installed collectors stay at 1b1b64d and are verified by pinned component continuity checks
impact.deployment_impact: Native API/frontend Git deploy of CI/verifier-only code. No collector upload, no DDL, no provider variable/cron/budget/writer mutation.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the previous workflows and verifier. No persistent state, collector image, schema or provider configuration is changed, so no data restore is applicable.
recovery.trigger: Scope step skips a change that touches anything outside the documentation allowlist, any collector/schema change observed, verifier retry masking a non-timeout failure, or engineering-gate failure
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no database or provider state changes. PR80 collector deployments remain installed and unchanged.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verification run for this merge, then the next natural turn of every collector still on 1b1b64d with unchanged schedules, flags and budgets
